title: Focused scene examples
summary: Learn one Retiam feature at a time through small, editable scenes.

blocks.text: Each scene below has one visual subject and one learning goal. The surrounding explanation names the API responsible for the result and proposes a single-variable experiment.

cells.text: Scene, hierarchy, layout, transforms and paint
Paths, Bézier curves, booleans, modifiers, subdivision and procedural shapes
LaTeX, function plotting, noise and MSDF fonts
Easing, sequencing, trackers, updates, morphing and camera motion
3D models, SDF, masks, instancing, input, shaders and render targets
Charts, graphs, automata, physics, images, audio and subtitles

blocks.text: The complete [repository example collection](/examples-catalog) includes runnable integration scenes, stress tests, galleries and historical fixtures with editable source and authored guidance. Use it after learning a feature through a focused scene, or when you need a larger real-world implementation.
